findings.title: Possible Boolean-based SQL Injection
findings.description: The parameter behaved like the baseline when a TRUE condition was supplied, but behaved differently when a FALSE condition was supplied.
findings.evidence: Parameter: id; Baseline status: 200; TRUE status: 200; FALSE status: 404; Baseline response size: 13 bytes; TRUE response size: 13 bytes; FALSE response size: 17 bytes; Baseline/TRUE similarity: 1.00; Baseline/FALSE similarity: 0.87; Confidence: HIGH
